Scouting Summary

Common themes

  • Left Orthodox, averaging 84.2 kph (up to 95.2).
  • Typical length is 3-4m (their good length); median 4.3 m.
  • Stock ball is full wide outside off, passing outside off (22% of deliveries).
  • Goes round the wicket 55% of the time against left-handers.
  • Across an over he holds a fairly consistent length.

Biggest threats

  • Most dangerous length is Good Length (4 wkts, 3.7% adjusted strike).
  • Danger pitching line: Stumps (mostly round the wicket (56%)).
  • Takes 33% of wickets pitching a good length on the stumps.
  • Beats the bat 2.5% of tracked balls (false-shot 16.3%).
  • Gets you caught behind more than most — 69% of his wickets (1.2× the typical rate for this type).
  • 0% of catches are behind the wicket (keeper / slips / gully).

Areas to exploit

  • Concedes most runs pitching full wide outside off (25% of runs).
  • Away from good length, the wicket threat drops off — look to score in the less-productive lengths.
  • Most of his runs leak square/through the off side (41%) — his main scoring release.
  • Cash in when he goes full in the channel (economy 6.4, beats the bat only 9%).
